actions.name: adhesive (object form only)
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: [[/attack]] ([[lookup @activation.condition activity=Hx8Io6Uz1mJDm4Nf]]), reach [[lookup @range.value activity=xWlMeXFjELfSUWX9]] [[lookup @range.units activity=xWlMeXFjELfSUWX9]]. Hit: [[/damage average activity=xWlMeXFjELfSUWX9]] damage—or [[/damage average activity=Hx8Io6Uz1mJDm4Nf]] damage if the target is Grappled by the mimic.

actions.name: pseudopod
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.

actions.name: shape-shift
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} shape-shifts to resemble a [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=EU2q25V5hIaM1ZlR]] object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.
